column1: # seats.tsv: ONE SEAT TABLE for seat-tick.sh, seat-relaunch.sh, seat-exit.sh (tab-separated; # comments and blank lines allowed)
# role = row key in controller-model-required (model lives there, not here); goal_pattern = ERE matched against goal.md lines (the seat /goal line);
# tick_min = timer cadence (must equal seat-tick@.timer OnUnitActiveSec; checked by seat-tick.sh --selftest); timeout_sec = ceiling for one turn
# (must be <= seat-tick@.service TimeoutStartSec); old_pid = interactive process that must exit first (guard), - = none.
